next_action: Iteration 20 built task 2.1c's second slice: D8 step 2's bracket-expression relaxation, wired into the same `_glob_links` (still rule 5 only, absolute words). Added `_bracket_expression_end(pattern, start)` (finds the closing `]` as bash scans for it, past an optional leading `!`/`^` and a `]` directly after that, with `[:`/`[=`/`[.` read as their own sub-bracket classes; None when a `[` has no closing `]`) and `_relax_bracket_pattern(pattern)` (relaxes each bracket expression to `?` when it opens with `!`/`^` or holds a `[`, `\`, or backtick -- what `fnmatch` cannot read as the shell does -- and keeps every other one exact for `fnmatch`). `_glob_links` now matches against `_relax_bracket_pattern(pattern)` instead of the raw pattern, and the exclusion that used to skip any pattern holding `[` now reads `_GLOB_CHARS` (`*?[`) instead of `*?` alone, so a pure bracket pattern like `[u]p` (no `*`/`?`) is no longer skipped. Added one standalone test, test_an_absolute_glob_word_s_bracket_expression_is_relaxed_like_the_shell_reads_it, to hub/tests/test_the_shell_judge_reads_a_word_whole.py.
